verdicts.reason: A: the sea and sky photo is gone, and the blue panel now fills the whole canvas. The headline wraps so that 'sale' sits alone on the last line, and the centered logo sits over a left-aligned headline. On the right, the badge, the CTA and the supporting copy are jammed into one row with the copy after the button, and the glasses float in empty space. B: it keeps the photo, but the panel is off-centre and runs to the top and bottom edges. An oversized Meridian logo sits on the busy photo and collides with the panel edge. The glasses are jammed against the top edge, the 'UP TO 40% OFF' badge is squashed into a tiny oval and cannot be read, and the CTA is minuscule. A is slightly less broken because it has no collisions and all of its text can be read.
